avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: P-gp inducer reduces ledipasvir plasma concentrations significantly, compromising HCV treatment efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort at least 2 weeks before and during ledipasvir therapy

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent P-gp and OATP inducer markedly decreases ledipasvir bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if tuberculosis treatment required, consult specialist for alternative regimen

avoid_supplements.name: Carbamazepine
avoid_supplements.mechanism: P-gp inducer reduces ledipasvir levels and antiviral efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Use alternative anticonvulsant; if unavoidable, monitor HCV RNA closely

caution_supplements.name: Garlic (high-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild P-gp induction at very high doses
caution_supplements.action: Monitor ledipasvir efficacy if using pharmacologic doses; dietary garlic is safe

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase ledipasvir levels unpredictably; P-gp inhibition affects absorption
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate grapefruit products during ledipasvir treatment

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May enhance ledipasvir absorption slightly; consistent intake recommended
caution_foods.action: Take ledipasvir with food consistently; meal type (fat content) less critical than adherence

monitoring_notes: Ledipasvir requires administration with food to optimize bioavailability and is substrate for P-gp and OATP transporters, making it susceptible to significant drug interactions. Monitor HCV RNA at standard intervals; any virologic breakthrough warrants assessment for concurrent P-gp-inducing agents.
